claim: The inference type is named for the ampliative move it records. A deduction's conclusion is contained in its premises and can fail only when a premise fails; deductive consequences are infinite and free, so the graph never stores them. An inference's conclusion outruns its deps - a generalization or an abduction - which is why it can be falsified while every dep stays true, and why the supersession-on-falsification lifecycle exists for it. The compound is the one entailment the schema stores (conjunction introduction), with subject containment as its formal shadow; the epistemic work a compound records is the selection of what to assemble. Type membership tracks the deps-to-claim relation, never the author's mental act, which is why the verifier interrogates scope rather than asking what kind of reasoning the author believes they performed.

evidence.detail: Naming rationale from the D1 debate, decided for 'inference' over retaining 'implication': an implication licensed to state more than its premises imply is a contradiction in terms; the falsified-while-deps-stand lifecycle is the structural proof these nodes exceed their premises; the contract kind 'implies' sits on the prescriptive side, so reusing 'implication' descriptively would put one lexeme on both sides of the is/ought boundary. Preflight 2026-06-10: tag/claim-overlap matches only (dag-schema contract family, 14 contract-level / 24 schema); reviewed per b032 - overlap is necessary but not sufficient for contradiction: no semantic conflict with active structure, since this primitive attests the v2 design record and prescribes nothing; the genuine tension with b026's three-value type enum resolves through the staged b026/b027/b029/b031/b032/b038 supersessions this primitive feeds in plan-2, per the b467/b040 precedent.
